claim_text: On December 16, 2025, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned an indictment in United States v. Kaamil Omar Sallah, No. 0:25-cr-00482 (ECF 1), charging Sallah with Counts 1–4, wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. § 1343, through SafeLodgings, Inc. Each count is an alleged interstate email: Count 1, on or about March 15, 2024, from Kaamil Sallah to Conspirator 1 including electronic health records login information; Count 2, on or about May 22, 2024, email exchanges with Kaamil Sallah concerning purported beneficiary Imani C.; Count 3, on or about July 12, 2024, from Kaamil Sallah attaching a client list; Count 4, on or about October 27, 2024, to Kaamil Sallah concerning purported beneficiary J. Johnson. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts.
